comments.body:
We have merged all the EOF discussions (1.1 and 2.0) into this "unified spec": https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/B1nnZ1fl3

This contains all the changes required/useful for achieving clean contract creation while banning code and gas observability.

We should discuss whether we want to propose this scope of changes for a single rollout or still think about two-staged rollout.

Thanks for sharing the unified spec! I’ll take a look at it. As for the rollout, I think it’s worth discussing the pros and cons of a single versus two-stage rollout. A single rollout could streamline things, but a two-stage approach might offer more flexibility and allow us to address any potential issues in stages. Let’s talk through it in more detail!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thanks 
[Rizwan](https://xtrasaas.com)
